info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Recovery Management API
info.description: The Account Recovery Management API allows users to initiate the process of recovering their accounts by providing necessary identification information. This endpoint is primarily aimed at customers who have lost access to their accounts and need to verify their identity for secure account reinstatement. It supports various account recovery scenarios, enhancing customer experience and reducing downtime. Developers can utilize this API to integrate account recovery functionalities into their applications, ensuring seamless and secure user access restoration.

get.summary: Retrieve account recovery information for a customer.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the account recovery details for a specific customer. Use this to assist customers in recovering their accounts when they encounter issues accessing their accounts.
